<br />
<strong>TL;DR:</strong> When two companies work on the same transaction, one can securely pass a customer's verified KYB or KYC record to the other through AiPrise. The receiving partner reuses the checks that meet its policy, runs any others it needs, and asks follow-up questions through the same token.</p>
<p><img src="/media/?type=post&id=128124&key=user_uploads%2F991872%2F54396a0f-a7e4-421e-8d6b-39a9cc74e041&variant=large" alt="uploaded image" /></p>
<p><br />
<strong>The problem</strong><br />
We were KYB'd 27 times in our first six months. Every bank, payment provider and vendor asked for the same documents and checked the same registries. On AiPrise, repeat business verifications are up 6x in the past year, and some businesses have been verified by as many as 13 different companies. One cross-border payment can involve an on-ramp, a payout partner and local banks, and each of them onboards the same customer from scratch.<br />
<br />
Today compliance teams have two options: accept another institution's verification as-is, or start over. Neither works well.<br />
<br />
<strong>What we built</strong><br />
Token Sharing gives teams a middle path. Instead of a pass/fail result, the receiving company gets the underlying evidence: the information provided, the checks run, the sources used and the audit trail. With the customer's consent, it can:</p>
<ul>
<li>Reuse the checks that meet its own policy</li>
<li>Run only the extra checks it needs</li>
<li>Raise follow-up questions through the same token, without chasing documents over email (today that typically takes 3–5 days)</li>
</ul>
<p>The token stays active for the life of the customer relationship, and each company keeps its own policies, records and decisions.<br />
<br />
<strong>Launch partners</strong><br />
AlfredPay, BlindPay, Conduit, dLocal, KAST, Mesta, MoneyGram, nsave, Saber Money, Tazapay and Walapay.<br />
<br />
<strong>Our ask</strong><br />
If you work with partners who onboard the same customers as you (payments, stablecoins, payouts, lending, card issuing), we'd love to talk. Book time at <a href="http://aiprise.com/schedule-demo">aiprise.com/schedule-demo</a> or reply here.</p>
